title: Soviet Myasishchev-4 (Bison) bomber with escort fighters, Chapter 1 p. 21
description: Black-and-white photograph of a large swept-wing Soviet bomber with red-star markings flying above two smaller jet fighters. Captioned "Soviet Myasishchev-4 bomber (the Bison)." Text below, under "The Air Force Intelligence Systems Panel," notes that published photographs of the Bison raised fears about Soviet bomber strength.
